items.title: A morphism carrying a relatively ample invertible sheaf is separated
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a morphism admitting an ample invertible sheaf relative to it is separated. The proof uses locality of separatedness on the base to reduce to an affine base with an ample invertible sheaf, where the statement is quoted from the corresponding result about ample sheaves.
